definitions.gloss: thoroughly; from beginning to end; completely; through and through
definitions.explanation: An emphatic expression meaning to do something consistently and completely, without wavering or compromising, from start to finish.

examples.japanese: {徹頭徹尾|てっとうてつび}⟦{反対|はんたい}した→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{徹頭徹尾|てっとうてつび}⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いた→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧。
examples.english: He stuck to his opinion through and through.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{徹頭徹尾|てっとうてつび}シリアスな⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{笑|わら}える→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This movie was serious through and through, without a single funny scene.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning "piercing head, piercing tail" — thorough from the very beginning (⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧) to the very end (⟦{尾|お}→尾：01898_o⟧). {徹|てつ} means to penetrate or go through completely.

USAGE:
A formal, emphatic adverb used primarily in written language and formal speech. Emphasizes unwavering consistency.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徹頭徹尾|てっとうてつび}⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧ (to oppose completely)
- {徹頭徹尾|てっとうてつび}⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧ (to maintain consistently)
- {徹頭徹尾|てっとうてつび}⟦{一貫|いっかん}している→一貫する：26972_ikkansuru⟧ (to be consistent throughout)
